column1: # Every source line in src/ by which a threshold override is read or applied.
# WHAT PRODUCED IT: enumeration-override-read-channels.py — line-level regex over
# every .php file under src/, five patterns: `->getThresholdOverride(` (the only
# access, which covers transport as well as reads), `->withOverride(` /
# `->withVoOverride(` (the application sites on options objects), and the two
# second delegates to the first, so it is a consumer path, not a third read.
# WHAT IT CANNOT SEE: a read performed through reflection or a variable method
# name; a collaborator handed `$context` that reads the map (only two such reads
# exist, both listed); tests/ (out of scope — the claim is about production);
# a future rule receiving the overrides through a constructor instead of the

# WHY IT MATTERS: leave-one-out is faithful only if every consumer of a
